content:
It was a wonderful experience to be a part of Samvidhan Manthan 2026, organised by the Moot Court Committee in collaboration with the Research Committee, Institute of Legal Studies, Ranchi University.

I feel privileged to have shared the platform with fellow speakers Ms. Aditi Apoorva, Ms. Sharda Munda and Ms. Apurwa Kumari. Such academic interactions provide a meaningful opportunity to exchange ideas, perspectives and experiences.

My sincere gratitude to the Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor, Prof. (Dr.) Saroj Sharma; Dean of Student Welfare, Dr. Smriti Singh; Director, Centre for Vocational Studies, Dr. A. K. Delta; and Director, Institute of Legal Studies, Prof. (Dr.) Acharya Rishi Ranjan, for their invitation and encouragement of academic collaboration.

Special appreciation to Mr. Priyanshu Kumar Tripathy, Programme Coordinator, for his dedicated efforts in conceptualising and coordinating the programme.

Heartfelt thanks to Jitisha (Moderator), Swastik (Technical Support), Mahwish and Sharik for their sincere contributions. Special thanks to Dr. Ishne for delivering the vote of thanks.

Grateful to the entire team of ILS, Ranchi University, for creating such a wonderful academic platform.

Looking forward to many more meaningful academic engagements!
